title: Grateful Dead Live at Meadowlands Arena on 1985-11-10
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Taped and transferred by Andrew F. 05/2014
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Sony UCXS90 (1st set) & TDK MA90 (2nd set) with no Dolby. Set up last row of floor far right (stage left) side.

ai_review.summary: Clear bonafide soundboard capture of a sharp 1985 Meadowlands show, highlighted by a ripping Mississippi Half‑Step → I Know You Rider transition.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this recording as a solid, well‑captured performance. The band is noted for being especially tight in 1985, with the standout Mississippi Half‑Step into I Know You Rider and a second set that makes listeners wish they were there. Technical notes commend the rig placement in the famed Byrne echo chamber, resulting in good overall sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are high (4‑5 stars) and emphasize a strong performance plus a clean recording, yielding an above‑average combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a bonafide capture with the rig placed in the Byrne echo chamber, providing clear and balanced audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The Meadowlands show is noted for its unique energy; the second set in particular is described as sharp and immersive, with seamless transitions.
